correctness.rationale: The 5-branchpoint tame (Z/2)^4 cover of P1 has genus 5 by Riemann–Hurwitz (2g-2=-32+5·8=8). Five even characters ramified at four points give five elliptic quotients. Pullbacks and norms compose to diagonal multiplication by 8 (off-diagonal vanish by involution characters), so a prime-to-3 isogeny identifies 3-divisible groups, and p-rank/a-number sum over the elliptic factors. In char3 Legendre y²=x(x-1)(x-r) has Hasse invariant proportional to -(1+r), so the fourth branch point that makes a fixed triple supersingular is unique (r=-1). Distinct five-sets thus have at most one supersingular four-subset. The five explicitly stated equations lambda+1, mu+1, lambda+mu, lambda+mu+1, lambda*mu+lambda+mu vanish on pairwise disjoint loci in U. Each is rational with exactly q-3 points over F_(3^m), m>=2: total nonordinary 5(q-3), ordinary (q-3)(q-7). Independent F9 direct arithmetic confirmed 30 vs 12 and read exact saturation Groebner verifier for all ten pairwise intersections. Claims only on smooth U and ordered rational branch points; finite counts do not prove the geometric isogeny.
